schema_ddl:
CREATE TABLE employees (employee_id NUMBER PRIMARY KEY, first_name VARCHAR2(50), job_id VARCHAR2(20), salary NUMBER, department_id NUMBER);
CREATE TABLE departments (department_id NUMBER PRIMARY KEY, department_name VARCHAR2(50));
original_sql:
SELECT e.employee_id, e.first_name, d.department_name, e.salary
FROM employees e, departments d
WHERE e.department_id = d.department_id
  AND e.job_id = 'MANAGER'
  AND e.salary > 4250
gold_tuned_sql:
SELECT /*+ INDEX(e idx_emp_job_sal) */ e.employee_id, e.first_name, d.department_name, e.salary
FROM employees e, departments d
WHERE e.department_id = d.department_id
  AND e.job_id = :b1
  AND e.salary > :b2
